messages.content: Rewrite this one-day trip request the way a real traveller might type it: change the wording and the sentence order, informal is fine. Keep EVERY number, time (exactly as written, 24-hour HH:MM), money amount and place name exactly as written. Do not add, drop or change any requirement. Output only the rewritten request.

Starting at 11:00, I've got 11 hours and 55 minutes to spend. I can spend at most S$22. I definitely need to see Wings of Time and Tekka Centre. If there's time, I'd also like Buddha Tooth Relic Temple, National Orchid Garden and Singapore River Cruise. I want to be at Wings of Time no earlier than 19:40 and done there by 19:55. I'd like to spend 30 minutes at Tekka Centre. I'd like to spend 70 minutes at Singapore River Cruise.

response: Hey, I’ve got 11 hours and 55 minutes to kill starting at 11:00. I’m looking to spend at most S$22 total. I really need to hit up Tekka Centre (would like to spend 30 minutes there) and Wings of Time—I need to be at Wings of Time no earlier than 19:40 and finished by 19:55. If I can squeeze them in, I’d also love to see Buddha Tooth Relic Temple, National Orchid Garden, and a Singapore River Cruise (I’d like to spend 70 minutes at Singapore River Cruise).
